apps.localizedDescription:
feat(ios): adopt @albertovinaroz morphed tabbar via native segmented glass bar @luqmanfadlli
fix(details): start from the top of the list after re-sorting episodes @luqmanfadlli
feat(details): show the episode navigator for every season @luqmanfadlli
feat(details): add episode search, go-to and sort with a sticky bar @luqmanfadlli
feat add mini player and incognito mode in playback settings @chrisk325
feat(blur): add haze blur on bottom sheets for Android @chrisk325
fix(simkl): dedupe multi-season anime in Continue Watching @chrisk325
feat(epg): add EPG to Live TV and player @chrisk325
fix(progress): add progress bar to episode cards in details page @chrisk325
perf(home): make the full-bleed hero swipe and scroll smoothly @luqmanfadlli
fix(home): keep hero age rating bound to its own item @luqmanfadlli
feat(home): rework full-bleed hero and dynamic background @luqmanfadlli
fix(player): stop downloads re-pausing and fix libass overlay offset @chrisk325
feat(tracker): add WeTrakr with library, rating and scrobbling support @chrisk325
feat(ios): add native PiP with existing MPV VideoToolbox frames (#2248) @WhiteGiso
Fix dismissed shows staying hidden after marking episodes watched (#2244) @Laskco
Add non-AI Subtitle AutoSync for mobile add-on subtitles (#2143) @DavidVamaiotu
fix(i18n): localize generic Episode N titles like TV (#2241) @blueocean2308
fix next episode card timing and prefetch with heuristic post-credits (#2238) @skoruppa
Optimize custom poster URL resolving performance (#2239) @halibiram
fix: In Poster Card Style settings screen one toggle get bigger then other and pushed out of the screen safe area. (#2219) @AdityasahuX07
